school.school_name: 大原医療秘書福祉専門学校大宮校

manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Preserve the O-Hara group table-header pattern where each link says only PDF but the same table column header identifies the confirmation application form.
steps: Start from the Saitama official-index disclosure URL https://www.o-hara.ac.jp/about/joho/.
Find the 大宮校 section, then the 大原医療秘書福祉専門学校大宮校 subsection.
Use the table header row: 授業科目一覧 / シラバス / 成績評価方法 / 卒業認定方針 / 確認申請書.
For 医療事務学科１年制, take the fifth PDF link under 確認申請書: https://www.o-hara.ac.jp/about/joho/pdf/2025-1-37-01-5.pdf.

Classify it as the latest visible target-form candidate, but reject it from strict FY2026 success because the URL names 2025 and no 2026/令和8 confirmation-form evidence is visible on the official page.

reusable_rules: When a disclosure table link label is only PDF, attach the same-column header text to the candidate context.
If the table header is 確認申請書 and the page title supplies 修学支援新制度 context, treat the PDF as a target-form candidate.
Old-year table-header target forms should become publication-lag evidence rather than generic non-target PDFs.
anti_patterns: Do not apply the 確認申請書 header to neighboring columns such as 授業科目一覧, シラバス, 成績評価方法, or 卒業認定方針.
Do not count 2025 confirmation-form PDFs as strict FY2026 success.

evidence.notes: Codex manual RCA on 2026-05-12 checked the live O-Hara official disclosure page. Current-code focused discovery for school_id=212 produced fiscal_year_mismatch:2025 for the fifth table-column PDF under 確認申請書.
